The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has two pages. I checked both, and five books on them are rated five stars. The other four cost £23.05 or more.

The tab I opened is still open, on the first page of the Mystery category.

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin.org accepted it. The response page echoes back these values:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

I worked only in the tab I opened, and I left it open on the response page at https://httpbin.org/post.

The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, shows "Thank you for your order!" and is still open in my tab.

I logged in as standard_user and sorted the products by price from low to high. I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light, then checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001.

The order summary showed an item total of $39.98 (Bike Light $9.99 plus Backpack $29.99), tax of $3.20 and a total of **$43.18**.

The browser tool's normal clicks didn't register on this site's buttons. I added the items and finished the checkout by triggering those buttons through the page's own script instead.
